name: Zentree Ultima WP Ply
description: The Ultimate Benchmark — When your project demands perfection, settle for nothing less than Zentree Ultima. Designed for those who refuse to compromise, our flagship BWP-grade plywood is the gold standard for long-term structural integrity. Crafted from a premium fusion of 100% Gurjan and Nilgiri timber, every board is double-calibrated to ensure flawless consistency. The signature 4-stage pressing process creates an ultra-high-density core that is fully immune to termites and borers. With near-zero core gaps and exacting thickness tolerances, Zentree Ultima isn't just a material—it’s an investment. Backed by a lifetime warranty, it is the last word in strength for the spaces you care about most.
features: Signature 4-stage pressing process for ultra-high-density core
Termite, borer proof and near-zero core gaps

name: Zentree Gold WP Ply
description: Versatility Meets Strength — Your home is your sanctuary—don’t settle for anything less than uncompromising durability. Engineered with a premium red core and a cutting-edge, borer-and-termite-free formulation, Zentree Gold WP Ply is built to withstand the toughest household environments. Whether it’s the constant humidity of a high-traffic kitchen or the heavy-duty demands of bespoke wardrobes, our unique blend of Neem, Gurjan, and Nilgiri ensures your furniture remains as pristine as the day it was installed. Invest in the foundation your home deserves.
features: Premium Red Core for visual quality assurance
Engineered for high-moisture kitchens & bespoke wardrobes
Durable blend of Neem, Gurjan, and Nilgiri (Eucalyptus)

name: Zentree Neem Gurjan Com Ply
description: The Premium Standard — Elevate your home interiors with the precision of our neo-calibrated Neem-Gurjan plywood. Expertly engineered from a high-performance blend of 100% select Neem and Gurjan timber, these boards marry the raw strength of Gurjan with the superior, pest-resistant durability of Neem. Specifically designed for elegant, high-end wardrobes and cabinetry, our consistent, full-thickness construction ensures a flawless finish and lasting stability. Choose the plywood that sets the benchmark for your most refined projects.
features: Consistent full-thickness profile for superior load-bearing

name: Zentree Project Com Ply
description: Optimization Without Compromise — When scaling a project, consistency is your greatest asset. Zentree Project Com Ply delivers the ideal convergence of value and durability, specifically designed for high-performance interior builds. With uniform thickness and reliable structural integrity, our boards ensure a seamless finish and lasting strength for every wardrobe project. Choose the ply that supports your design vision and your bottom line.

specs.Wood Species: Mix of Neem and other species

features: Optimized blend of Neem & select hardwood
Ideal convergence of value and durability
